lines.check: The overview page's first paragraph states the outcome the reader gets, not the implementation.
Within every page, sections are ordered general to specific.
Every code block appears before the prose that discusses it, never after.
No orphan reference entries: every reference page is reachable from a mention on at least one guide page (overview, quick-start, or task-guide).
Support content, when present, comes last in the page order.
